patch_description: The current candidate uses only a nearest-neighbor ZZ ring (8 edges) for entangling, while the higher-scoring prior seed (score 0.72) enriched connectivity with additional "opposite-qubit" and "skip-2" ZZ couplings, all sharing the same `zz_ring` parameter name (so no new trainable parameters are introduced). This extra connectivity gives the ansatz more expressive power to separate the hardest validation group (worst_group_margin) without any parameter-count penalty, at the cost of a modest depth increase. I apply the same idea here: after the nearest-neighbor ring, add the opposite-qubit couplings (i, i+4) and the skip-2 shell (i, i+2 mod 8), all still under the shared `zz_ring` parameter. This mirrors the recommendation to clone/deepen the entangling block while keeping the parameter economy intact.
